name: qic-tests
description: Automated checks for the QIC Service app: app loads, Firestore/Storage rules by role, and key flows against the Firebase emulator. Run with `npm test` from this folder (needs Java 21 for the emulator).

scripts.test: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-qic "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.js"
